items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base-ui button primitive with variant and size. Use for primary actions on forms and lists. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface container (header, title, description, content). Use on detail pages and summary tiles such as a party's running balance. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field layout (group, label, description). Use when building a party form or any labeled control cluster. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn and lite/label is present.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Base-ui text input primitive. Use on create/edit forms (party name, amounts). Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label primitive. Use next to inputs; Field composes it. Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: HTML table primitives for lists (parties, open balances, ledger lines). Assumes src/lib/utils exports cn.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn helper
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge `cn()` helper. Use when a component needs className merging. Assumes the base runtime serves clsx and tailwind-merge.
